ms.report:
A. Output: Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
What was delivered:
A complete Software Requirements Specification (SRS) document defining the functional and non-functional requirements for all funded components of the project.
The SRS covers:
・Zero-Knowledge (ZK) content stamping protocol
・Licensing smart contracts
・Human Intelligence Data Marketplace (frontend & backend)
・Attribute-Based Encryption (ABE) module
・Architecture overview, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability

Acceptance criteria:
SRS covers all components from the funded proposal (ZK, Licensing, Marketplace, ABE).
Evidence:
https://github.com/Nucastio/MidnightZK-Data-Marketplace-for-Authentic-Human-Data-Nuauth/blob/main/Software_Requirements_Specification_MidnightZK_Data-Marketplace_for_Authentic_Human_Data.pdf
B. Output: Technical Feasibility Study
What was delivered:
A technical feasibility study included within the SRS evaluating the viability of implementing Zero-Knowledge proofs and Attribute-Based Encryption on Cardano and Midnight ZK. The study analyzes architectural constraints, off-chain/on-chain separation, and implementation considerations.
Acceptance criteria:
Feasibility study confirms technical viability for ZK proofs and ABE implementation on Cardano.
Evidence:
https://github.com/Nucastio/MidnightZK-Data-Marketplace-for-Authentic-Human-Data-Nuauth/blob/main/Software_Requirements_Specification_MidnightZK_Data-Marketplace_for_Authentic_Human_Data.pdf
C. Output: Project Plan & Risk Register
What was delivered:
An 8-week project plan outlining task breakdown, timeline, and ownership across all deliverables, along with a risk register identifying key technical and delivery risks and corresponding mitigation strategies.
Acceptance criteria:
Project plan includes timeline details of all planned project tasks.
Evidence:
Project plan, Gantt chart, and risk register are produced as part of the milestone documentation and referenced within the SRS.
